scripts.postinstall:
node -e "console.log('
  Fuutu Stack — Free for teams ≤ 10 employees or ≤ $250k/yr revenue.
  Enterprise license required once you exceed both (see LICENSE.md §3, §4).
  Get your key at https://fuutustack.com/pricing
  Opt-out of telemetry pings: FUUTU_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1
')"
scripts.test:e2e: cross-env FUUTU_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 dotenv -c -- turbo run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:all: cross-env FUUTU_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 PW_ALL_BROWSERS=1 dotenv -c -- turbo run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:all:saas: cross-env FUUTU_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 PW_ALL_BROWSERS=1 dotenv -c -- turbo -F @fuutu/saas test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:all:marketing: cross-env FUUTU_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 PW_ALL_BROWSERS=1 dotenv -c -- turbo -F @fuutu/marketing test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:ui:saas: cross-env FUUTU_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 dotenv -c -- pnpm -F @fuutu/saas exec playwright test --ui
scripts.test:e2e:ui:marketing: cross-env FUUTU_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 dotenv -c -- pnpm -F @fuutu/marketing exec playwright test --ui
scripts.test:visual:update: cross-env FUUTU_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 dotenv -c -- pnpm -F @fuutu/saas exec playwright test tests/visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots && cross-env FUUTU_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 dotenv -c -- pnpm -F @fuutu/marketing exec playwright test tests/visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.test:setup: pnpm -F @fuutu/saas exec playwright install chromium && pnpm -F @fuutu/marketing exec playwright install chromium
scripts.test:clean: rm -rf apps/saas/test-results apps/saas/playwright-report apps/saas/tests/.auth apps/saas/tests/visual.spec.ts-snapshots apps/marketing/test-results apps/marketing/playwright-report apps/marketing/tests/visual.spec.ts-snapshots .playwright-mcp-artifacts/* && echo 'Playwright artifacts cleaned.'
